items.note: States h=100, v, N=v^3, m=h^3, the forward gadget y_S <- y_S + x_S for arbitrary scratch values and the three-stage composition to (-Y_a, X_a). Derivation follows the proof: net change (JV+RG)x, the case analysis on |S cap T| in both constructions (coefficients checked against 752-758), the shear chain (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and the wire counts W_b, W_c match 778-781.

Frames D_v with edge change D_v D_u^{-1}, commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate by R-linearity, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} including auxiliary roles; this is the invariant argument of 804-825.

Gives the bilinear form with <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, the full residual table (every row checked against 1024-1041), that only center 3->4 decreases (by h), L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539, 101/539. The gate-label table eq:motif-labels is not reproduced (it is implicit in the residuals), and the F_2 orthonormal-basis claim is only stated, without the nonalternating argument of 1073-1102.

Has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N negative source projections giving first edge matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, frames Phi_M and the shear H<-H+D on every role (S1.8.3). The matrix assignment is only implicit: P_U at gates and sinks and zero at the other sources is never stated, and S1.5.8 writes the X_a endpoint formula as if it held on every role.

States C=aI+bX, the frames C_U=H^{(m)} diag(i^{q_U}) H^{(m)}, one translation kernel per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and C^{(mk)} on every role. The derivation follows 1232-1314: weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving a kernel or its inverse, the Z-corrections on the 27 support coordinates, and undoing the signed exchange. However q_U(x)=wt(P_U x) mod 4 is never defined, so the frame formula is incomplete.

Gives L/N<1/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, the exact eta_b and eta_c, eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is exactly the paper's route at 1319-1344.

Both lemmas are stated: the O(V) digit operations and cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, and the controlled shift and fixed-unit scaling, with the b^{O(1)} offset condition in S1.2.2. The proofs match 513-527 and 574-604 (split on digits, r=Wg+w, cut at Q-a, c increasing pieces). Negation and the counter details are omitted.

Gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 by the topmost-row, rightmost-entry pivot elimination, the fixed odd prime, triangular transforms in descending order, the conjugation sequence and the three-step interchange (h,d)->(h+d,d). I checked that sequence by hand. There are exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), as at 1375-1446.

Covers the cyclic row split into W role streams, the Phi_M frames with each edge as rank-many recursive interchanges, the endpoint shear, D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and its geometric solution to O(e^tau). It also gives the fixed-tape depth-first schedule and the descriptor bound V_j>=q^{2e_0}, all as in 1491-1615.

Gives the O(V u^tau) bound and the reduction of 1649-1734: rho=O(log e) high digits form the row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, zero rows pad to R'<2R, the base-m split of e-rho with O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(V e^tau), and padding [2^u] to [q^e]. The one-bit unequal-width case of 1740-1761 is included.

Has the basic identities H_0=bSCS and C^{-1}=-iZCZ, conjugation by P_M moving residual directions to coordinate slots, the inverse child (C^{-1})^{(f)}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, H_0^{(D)}=b^D S_D C^{(D)} S_D, and the basis change as a fixed number of row additions done by packed calls. This matches 1835-1940 and 2210-2231.

Covers the eight operations and their cycles composing to (00 10)(01 11), the guard interval [10, 2^{K-1}-11] and delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, and T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B. It then gives the swaps and rotations, the extraction and radix-sort repair, and the cost with its family simplification, all as in 2013-2207.

Gives individual kernels at O(Ve), node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks with R_row>=W^{k_0} and padding, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) for e<d^beta, the internal sum O(e^lambda), the leaf bound e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). The route is that of 2286-2445.

States the layer on one selected bit per chunk, the O(V d^{lambda'}) cost and the error below sqrt2*2^{-p}. Derives the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) by the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E (constants match 2459-2557), and the final truncation via the absolute row sum one. The band-uniform check that the packed lemma's hypotheses hold (A_*<=C_A p, K>=6) at 2700-2730 is not spelled out.

Has character cancellation by the shift-by-t/2^{v+1} pairing, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1} via H_0^2=I/2, and the combined twiddle J_E. The layout L uses prefix slot moves and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges. Also present are truncation commuting with J_E, error sqrt2*ell*2^{-p}, the cost terms and the operators L B F^- and F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1}, as in 2819-3195.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, carries in {-1,0}, centred extraction, negacyclic reduction and the shift by p+ell, as in 3233-3366.

Two forward transforms in the retained LB order (justified by P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v) in the motivation), the normalization identity, the bilinear error 2delta, then 3delta+eta and the scale by M giving sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p}, and the cost, matching 3414-3495.

The steps run N=CTD, the quoted identity TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS with ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}, the Neumann inversion, and A=S/2 with B_0=D'J'C as contractions. They give the normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, the error and time table, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, the line counts and the O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)) axis exposure, as in 3576-3896.

The chirp is periodic for even t_i, and the coefficient computation shows Q reads frequency -s_i j_i. Then F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ by h=ck, so R F^+ R=F^+, pointwise products commute with R, and the convolution rule with F^+F=I/S gives (u*v)/S^2. Conjugation gives RF^+. All as in 3938-3987.

Covers all fixed rationals, the size parameters and eq:sizes, the comparison constants, alpha, gamma, eta and gamma<28b^{2/3}, the prime-interval bound for x>e^{2/eta}, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the trial-division cost n^{o(1)}, no wraparound and c_j<2^{3b}. Matches 4016-4192.

The steps give the isomorphism (the image of x has order S), the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j, and padding by a nested scan. They then give updates in order i=d,...,1, rotation of the valid interval fixing the padding, and O(d^2) axis moves at O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)), as in 4216-4291.

Theta: x_d -> zeta y is well defined and diagonal, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j holds, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T. The computed twist with one truncation per phase product has error below 4h_p, as in 4303-4396 and 4566-4575.

The source transform runs A-tilde, then the chirp transform (x_0, y_0 and the endpoint phase), then B_0-tilde and the scale 2^gamma, with exact counterpart RF_s. F^+ comes by conjugation. The six steps are covered: digits scaled to a_j 2^{p-b-2}, Phi, two transforms, the product, F^+ and the scale S, then 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1} and carries. All match 4434-4533.

The error chain is E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL, then 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2) and (3E_s+2), and finally E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, with the disk margins. The final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 uses gamma<=b/4. Rounding gives c_j in [0,2^{3b}), and the carry recurrence comes with its bound and invariant. Matches 4546-4805.

Reproduces all nine table rows with their powers, the seven margins and their values with min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, and the justification of each row. It shows that setup and exceptional-stream sorting are o(V), that the fixed log-power slack is p^kappa, and gives the schoolbook cutoff, matching 4815-4995.

S0 says the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model and relies on 'n-log-n-conjecture'. No step states the content of 379-387: an eventual lower bound c_A n lg n for every machine, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, and the limit zero along all lengths.

errors.says: the endpoint difference is P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on every role
errors.paper: That expression is the endpoint difference only for the input role X_a, whose source matrix is -P_{U_a} and whose routed sink Y_a has label U_a^perp. Every other role has zero source matrix and identity sink matrix (1169-1171). The plan never states that the other sources get zero.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route throughout. S1 runs from the bank-exchange network (S1.3), frames (S1.4), the subspace labels and the rank budget s<Wm with tau=1-2^{-50} (S1.5), the triangular factorization and matrix shear (S1.6-S1.7) to the power-width recurrence and arbitrary widths (S1.8-S1.9). S2 builds the complex network's phase frames, packed row additions, layer recurrence and guard widths. Then come the synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), the resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (S4), the algorithm with exact recovery (S5), and the cost table with min g_i=2kappa giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) (S6). It thins only in local places: the gate-label table and the F_2 orthonormal-basis proof are stated without detail, q_U is never defined for the phase frames, and the band-uniform verification of the packed-lemma hypotheses inside the layer proof is not spelled out.

steps.note: h=100, v=C(100,3), N=v^3, m=h^3=10^6, and the banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3 are given. So is the fixed linear network whose three stages send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restore every scratch wire whatever its initial value.

A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate by R-linearity, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}. Only the edge changes D_v D_u^{-1} cost anything, and the endpoint frames fix each route's operator.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{(3)} of dimension m are nested along every edge. Neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, and the only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges, each losing h.
S1.5.8 states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N source exceptions, where the first edge matrix 2P_{U_a} has rank one although its dimension change is zero.
Signed changes telescope to Wm-2N, and the Ic decreasing edges of loss h give sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich. Adding the N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 gives s_b<W_b m (and 2N-2L_c>0 for the complex network).
S1.8.3 gives M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and the shear H<-H+D on every role, scratch roles included. S1.5.8 gives the X_a computation, though it loosely labels it as holding on every role.

A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular factors, and each one of Pi costs a single interchange, so a rank-a shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Each edge Phi_{A_e} makes rank(A_e) recursive calls, s in total at a node.
Children have volume V/W, F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). From eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine central steps are reconstructed with their defining content, in the paper's order. The fixed network, frames, labels, rank-equals-dimension with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict saving from L/N<1/2 and the endpoint identity feed the matrix-shear cost (a interchanges per rank-a edge) and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with s/W<m^{1-2^{-50}}. The only blemish is S1.5.8's loose wording of the endpoint formula as holding on every role.
